properties.name: log.db
properties.description: Legacy game/client log switch (Y or N). I19a quick match archives are always recorded.

properties.name: stomp.allowedOrigin
properties.description: Allowed origin in WebSocket config (accept requests only from this domain).

properties.name: app.database.path
properties.description: Writable application SQLite file, separate from the bundled read-only catalog.

properties.name: app.archive.retry-ms
properties.description: Delay between retries of immutable match analysis batches; never replays game commands.

properties.name: app.mail.enabled
properties.description: Explicitly enable SMTP; disabled sender otherwise fails without connecting.

properties.name: app.dev.seed-accounts
properties.description: Opt-in synthetic accounts, local profile and loopback binding only; existing identities are preserved.
